headline: AFRICANDO 2026 Scheduled to Deepen Commercial Ties Between Africa and US
summary: The Abia State Government announced that the 2026 edition of the African Diaspora Conference and Expo (AFRICANDO) will serve as a platform to translate international engagements into concrete investments between Africa and the United States.
why: Initiatives fostering bilateral trade and investment between developing regions and major economies can influence foreign direct investment inflows and regional commercial partnerships.
